Senses.Explanation: The great earth with its mountains and rivers. Yuanwu Keqin says the buddhas of the three times attain the way within it and it emerges from that one place, Chushi Fanqi teaches that seeing form is seeing mind and that the earth-and-rivers are mind, and Liao'an Qingyu makes the array utterly precarious and the earth-and-rivers steeply dangerous at the summer release. Wuyi Yuanlai displays the whole mechanism in a grain of dust and the earth-and-rivers in a single blade of grass, Yongjue Yuanxian turns the sheet of snow into a lion's roar at the opening of the training season, Shanyi Ruchun opens the straight eye until no inch of soil remains, Yuan'an Liao reads the snowbound field where mountains are no longer mountains as the earth-and-rivers beaten into one, Huiyue Xu has it beg for its life under the true man's tread, Tianyin Yuanxiu caps Cao Shan's exchange by making it the very eye, and Ruibai Mingxue covers it over entirely where no one is seen at the Jinsu gate.
